app.name: Lokkho
app.tagline: Know the marks you need, before results day
app.disclaimer: Grade scale, marks ranges and retake rules are editable defaults, not any university's official rules. Check them with your department. Curriculum data is a sample.
common.name: Name
rules.unverified: Marks ranges per grade and some rules are unverified defaults. Verify with your department.
onb.title: Set your goal
onb.intro: Pick your program, your current semester and the CGPA you want. Lokkho will show what you need next.
reg.title: Registered courses for semester {n}
reg.intro: Untick courses you did not register. You can add a retake or extra course and edit credits.
reg.empty: Add your courses or import them.
past.title: Past results
past.none: You are in semester 1, so there are no past results yet.
past.pasteHelp: Copy the text of your result page and paste it here. It is read in your browser only. Name and ID lines are ignored and never saved.
past.useAi: Format not recognised? Use AI import
past.noMatch: This does not look like the IIUC result format. Try the AI import, or enter grades by hand.
past.parsed: Result page read. Please review the grades below, then save.
past.warn.credits: Semester {sem}: credits are {computed} here but the page says {page}.
past.warn.gpa: Semester {sem}: GPA is {computed} here but the page says {page}.
past.warn.cgpa: CGPA is {computed} here but the page says {page}.
dash.status.on_track: On track. Your goal is already secured.
dash.status.needs: You need an average GPA of {gpa} from now on.
dash.best: Even with straight A+ the best CGPA you can reach is {best}.
dash.planNA: A plan appears when you still need a GPA between 0 and 4.00.
course.title: Course tracker
course.sofar: You have {got} marks. {left} of {total} marks are still to come.
course.schemePh: Paste the marking scheme, e.g. Attendance 10, Quiz 10, Mid 30, Final 50
exam.title: Exams coming up
retake.title: Retake & improvement simulator
retake.intro: See which retake or improvement raises your CGPA the most.
retake.mode.latest: latest attempt replaces the old one
retake.none: No eligible course would raise your CGPA.
coach.title: Study coach
coach.help: Gemma writes kind study tips from your numbers. It never calculates grades.
coach.rejected: {n} tip(s) were hidden because they contained numbers that were not in your data.
ai.label: AI suggestion
ai.manual: You can still enter everything by hand.
ai.reviewFirst: Review and edit before saving. Nothing is saved until you press the button.
ai.photo: Photo of the slip (optional, PNG/JPEG, under 2 MB)
ai.imageBig: That image is too large (max 2 MB).
ai.importTitle: Import courses from a registration slip or curriculum (AI)
ai.importHelp: Paste the text of a registration slip or curriculum. Do not paste personal details.
whatif.title: What-if question
whatif.help: Ask in English or Bangla. The AI only turns your question into a scenario. The numbers come from plain code.
whatif.ph: What if I get a 3.8 GPA in 15 credits?
whatif.unknown: I could not find the course {code} in your results.
dash.start.title: Add your past results to start
dash.start.body: Lokkho needs your earlier grades to work out the GPA you need next. It only takes a minute.
app.confirmReset: Delete all data stored in this browser?
advisor.title: AI Advisor
advisor.intro: Ask a question. The advisor checks your numbers with plain tools (no guessing), then explains the result.
advisor.q.each: What should I get in each course?
advisor.empty: Pick a quick question above, or type your own.
advisor.thinking: The advisor is checking your numbers…
advisor.ungrounded: Could not verify these numbers from the tools: {numbers}. Double-check them.
advisor.proposal.title: Proposal:
advisor.note: All numbers come from plain code. The AI only explains. Predictions are estimates based on stated assumptions.
advisor.disclaimer: Predictions are scenario ranges based on the marks you entered, not guarantees. Real results depend on your future marks and your university's rules.
ai.err.timeout: The AI took too long (over 30 seconds).
ai.err.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
ai.photoOff: Photo import is turned off: it is not verified to work with this model. Paste the text instead.
nodata.confirm: Replace your current entries with the SAMPLE student?
retake.nodata: Add your past results first, so Lokkho can show which retake helps most.
advisor.nodata: Add your past results or some marks first, so the advisor has numbers to check. You can also try the sample student.
advisor.failed: The AI could not write an explanation this time. Here is what the tools found:
